description: This file defines the WorkActivityStore class, which manages the state of various activities (jobs and tools) within the application. It handles starting and stopping activities, updating their state, and deriving visual representations such as icon states. The class is a singleton and uses @Observable for reactive updates in a SwiftUI context.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the state of current activities, including jobs and tools, handling their lifecycle, UI state updates, and activity resolution.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore.Activity
classes.description: A nested struct representing an activity with session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles the start or end of a job activity based on session key and state string.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Handles the start or end (or status update) of a tool activity based on session key, phase, name, meta, and arguments.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Updates the icon state based on the override selection.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key, trimming whitespace and updating state accordingly.
